title: britains energy price cap hit three year high in october cornwall insight says 2026 08 19
text:
LONDON, Aug 19 (Reuters) - Britain's domestic energy price cap is forecast to rise about 4% in October to a ​three-year high, analysts at Cornwall Insight said on Wednesday, with higher ‌wholesale costs due to the Iran war expected to wipe out the government's tax cut on electricity bills.
($1 = 0.7376 pounds)
